info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Status Retrieval API provides a standardized mechanism for clients to obtain the current status of their insurance claims. This endpoint allows users such as insurance agents, customer service representatives, and policyholders to easily check the progress and updates on their claims. By leveraging this API, businesses can improve customer satisfaction by providing timely information and transparency regarding claims processing. It is an essential tool for managing insurance claim inquiries efficiently.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status of their claims, providing important information on the processing and approval stages. It is essential for clients to monitor their claims effectively.
